name: RAVDESS: Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song
description: The Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song (RAVDESS) is a multimodal dataset of 7,356 recordings featuring 24 professional actors (12 female, 12 male) vocalizing lexically-matched statements in neutral North American accents. Expressed emotions include calm, happy, sad, angry, fearful, surprise, and disgust at normal and strong emotional intensities.
